label: Caltopo Sync Plugin Bridge
info:
Importable bridge tab exposing the Phase 2 plugin HTTP contract.

Endpoints:
  POST   /sync/run
  GET    /sync/pairs
  POST   /sync/pairs
  DELETE /sync/pairs/:id
  GET    /sync/health

The bridge is mostly additive. The legacy GET /api/CalTAKsync flow on the
'Caltopo <-> TAK' tab is left untouched. The ONLY modifications to legacy
nodes are wire-list appends on two existing terminal debug nodes
(sync04caltopoDebug, sync09takDebug) so the bridge can observe per-feature
completion signals. See README.md → 'What this import modifies'.

The POST /sync/run path triggers the existing fan-out change node
a075cdac694b8631, then waits for real per-feature completion signals
(via link-in cab1700800000003) and aggregates counts before responding
synchronously. No polling.

Postgres operations reference the existing postgresdb config node 0401336095afd0b1
(POSTGRES_HOST/POSTGRES_DB env-driven). On import, Node-RED will prompt if the
config node id is not present locally.

name: TAK DataSync Look Up
info:
This subflow retrieves the list of missions on a TAK Server and creates an array for the output to be used as pulldown menu list for a UI node

### INPUT:
1. Any injection / payload:
: msg.payload (timestamp) : A standard `inject` node will work with the node set to recur at a certain time interval - (2 - 5 minutes)
2. msg.takMission (string):  TAK Mission Name for guid look up (optional)

### OUTPUT:
1. An array of TAK Server DataSync Missions:
: msg.takMissionLookUpList (array) : An array containing TAK Server Missions (strings)
2. TAK Mission Guid:
: msg.missionGuid (string) : A TAK Mission GUID (null if no msg.takMission or if lookup unsuccessful)

meta.author: Paul Clifton <paul.clifton@clptak.com>
meta.desc: This node utilizes the Team Awareness Kit (TAK) Server Mission API to download a list of current DataSync Missions
